text:
**Available APRIL 1-JUNE 1 ** 2K PER MONTH** UTILITIES INCLUDED

Spacious East Village Studio | 333 E 17th St | 800+ Sq Ft

Located on the first floor of a classic East Village building, this expansive 800+ square foot studio at 333 E 17th Street is a rare downtown find. It offers a scale you almost never see in a studio, while still feeling grounded, calm, and intentionally minimal.

The apartment is clean, quiet, and remarkably versatile. The layout allows for distinct living and sleeping areas without interrupting the flow. A Japanese futon serves as the primary bed, and a Thai mattress is also available, offering flexibility for guests or alternate setups. The openness of the floor plan makes it ideal for someone who values space, simplicity, and room to breathe in the middle of Manhattan.

Hardwood floors run throughout, complemented by high ceilings and exposed brick that bring warmth and texture to the space. The fireplace mantle adds character, and the generous open floor area gives the studio a loft-like feel. It is understated and adaptable, whether left minimal or thoughtfully styled.

The kitchen is set apart from the main living area and includes full-sized appliances. The bathroom is clean and functional with classic tile and good separation from the rest of the apartment.
The location is truly exceptional. You are in the heart of the East Village, steps from Union Square, Stuyvesant Town, and Tompkins Square Park, surrounded by some of the best restaurants, cafés, bars, and markets in the city. The L train at 1st Avenue and the 4, 5, 6, N, Q, R, W at Union Square are all within close reach, making downtown, Midtown, and Brooklyn easily accessible.

Despite being at the center of it all, the apartment itself feels like a quiet landing place. It works beautifully as a short term creative retreat, whether you are in the city for work, writing, studying, rehearsing, or simply wanting to experience downtown New York with real space to live in.

For someone looking for real square footage, strong bones, and an unbeatable downtown address at a great value, this is a rare opportunity.

text:
AVAILABLE APRIL 12-JUNE 1ST $2400 ($1500/MONTH) UTILITIES INCLUDED

204 MacDonough is a beautiful apartment escape from the hustle and bustle of NYC. It is on a painstakingly beautiful and quiet street that is lined with pre-war brownstones. The apartment is located in a very kind and loving community, where nearly every building and street is lined with flowing trees, gardens and plants. After living in NYC for 26 years, in many different neighborhoods, I can confidently say that this is my favorite place that I have had the opportunity to live.

This is a recently renovated, sunny two bedroom apartment with a private fire escape to a backyard jungle of trees, countless birds as well as access to a roof. The windowed kitchen has custom cabinets, stone countertops and modern appliances. The bathroom boasts modern fixtures, porcelain tiles, a tub, as well as a window for proper ventilation. There are hardwood floors, high ceilings and excellent closet space throughout the unit. Heat and hot water are included in the rent. The Apt is on the top floor, so no noisy neighbors will be above you. As mentioned, there is a private fire escape with access to a roof with panoramic views of Manhattan. 

There are several laundromats within a two block radius of the apartment. The C train is a 2 block/3 minutes walk as well and gets you to downtown Manhattan in 20 minutes. You are steps away from countless amazing restaurants and bars as well as grocery stores, dollar stores and anything one might need can easily be found steps away on Fulton street. 

The building is fairly quiet with respectful and friendly neighbors. There is a space out front to lock one’s bike up (I have a moped) and we have near private/exclusive access to the roof. Living on the top floor provides an added benefit of not having any loud neighbors/heavy feet above you. With beautiful daily sunsets and amazing natural light, it is easy to get lost and find peace in a place like this.
